7/S0.subgoal: Describe the overall historical evolution and phases of Augmented Reality.

7/S1.subgoal: Describe the key technological advancements and innovations of the experimental phase of AR.

7/S2.subgoal: Explain the foundational academic research and precursor applications developed during the basic research phase.

7/S3.subgoal: Detail the types of technical developments and applications that characterized the tools and applications phase.

7/S4.subgoal: Analyze the turning points and factors driving the commercial adoption and growth of AR.

7/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main historical milestones and provide resources for further study on AR.
